subject: M027 authoring contracts, review evidence packs, and guide-system v0.6.0 review migration
acceptanceCriteria: Historical completed reviews are preserved and are not invalidated by later commits.
Every active pending review has one owning milestone.
Canonical IDs and ephemeral interactive aliases behave correctly.
Geometry and sound diagnostics are clear and stable across both consumers.
Review packs contain sufficient bounded evidence or explicit acceptable omissions.
No approval was fabricated during migration.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. A waiver is acceptable only after this request is explicitly amended to authorize one and the record states the reason.

decisionHistory.notes: Approved by repository user after reviewing the M027 authoring-contract, evidence-pack, and review-migration materials.
